answer: The design leans on escrowed payment for graded work, weighted by independent path length, the cheapest attack must cost more than honest work. The gale holds work receipts rather than names, so the pulse of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. Written in a one long clause plus a short one register, it stays short. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. By the jade of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up.
